title: agent.event
description: Event emitted by the Agent Team OS hook towards a terminal driver (Onda). Transport: JSON-RPC method 'agent.event' over the driver's unix socket, addressed by $ONDA_SOCKET. Fire-and-forget: the hook MUST NOT wait for a reply beyond the 200ms write timeout and MUST exit 0 regardless of outcome. PRIVACY INVARIANT: this payload never carries file contents nor prompt text - tool names and relative paths only.

v.description: Schema major version. A driver receiving an unknown v MUST discard the event silently.

event.description: Verbatim Claude Code hook_event_name. The hook switches on this value.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds, emitted by the hook (not the driver).

id.description: Claude Code session id. Stable for the whole session: it is the ring-buffer key on the driver side.

agentBin.description: Binary driving the session: 'claude' | 'codex' | 'qwen' | ... Absent when undetectable.

cwd.description: Absolute session cwd. Informational only: agent correlation uses onda.* env, NOT cwd.

onda.description: Terminal-driver correlation, inherited from the env the PTY injects into the shell. See CONTRACT.md 'Presence discriminant'.

terminalId.description: From $ONDA_TERMINAL_ID. Authoritative correlation key. The driver MUST discard the event when this does not resolve to a live terminal (see CONTRACT.md 'Trust model').

workspaceId.description: From $ONDA_WORKSPACE_ID. Absent for a terminal spawned outside a workspace.

agent.description: Agent identity as resolved by the hook via AGENT_MAP.rules[]. Absent when the cwd matches no rule and no fallback is set. Field names mirror AGENT_MAP.agents.<id> exactly - do not rename to display/god.

account.description: Claude account label when known. Free text, display only.

model.description: Model label when known. Free text, display only.

name.description: Tool name only, never its input.

target.description: Path RELATIVE to session.cwd, or null. MUST NOT be an absolute path outside cwd, MUST NOT carry file contents. For Bash this is null - never the command string.

subagent.description: Subagent type when the event comes from a spawned agent, else null.

ok.description: PostToolUse only: false maps to the 'error' state.

ctx.description: Context/quota gauges when the harness exposes them. Omit rather than guessing.

inbox.description: Agent Team OS inbox counters, so the driver can render the inbox row without reading the filesystem. Emitted on SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / Stop.

pending.description: Messages pending for this agent in the current workspace.

elsewhere.description: Messages pending whose context.project_path differs from cwd (v1.2 workspace filtering).

from.description: Sender agent ids, deduplicated. Ids only, never message bodies.
